name: Gamelan
author: Erin Carter
description: A rank of seven graded bronze bars rings in their free-bar standing-wave modes after hash-scheduled strikes, antinodes glowing while the nodal points stay pinned and dark, each bar decaying in place at its own length-keyed rate.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between strikes on any one bar, from a gently busy ensemble to rare lone notes.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: Scales every bar's sustain while keeping the short-bright to long-slow grading across the rank.

params.label: Bar width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of each bar, from slender chimes to broad slabs filling the rank.

params.label: Overtone
params.effect: Level of the second free-bar mode, adding a short-lived three-lobed sparkle atop each strike.
